#docs
## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `sub` | `string` | **yes** | Subscription id (sub_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is optional.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pause_option` | `string` | no | When the pause starts. One of `immediately`, `end_of_term`, `specific_date`, `billing_cycles`. |
| `pause_date` | `string · ISO-8601` | no | The date the pause starts (ISO-8601 UTC), for `specific_date`. |
| `skip_billing_cycles` | `integer` | no | Number of billing cycles to skip, for `billing_cycles`. |
| `unbilled_charges_handling` | `string` | no | `no_action` keeps pending charges for the resumption invoice, whatever the business default. One of `invoice`, `delete`, `no_action`. |
| `dunning_handling` | `string` | no | Whether dunning continues or stops while the subscription is paused. One of `continue`, `stop`. |
| `resume_date` | `string · ISO-8601` | no | Schedule the resume (returned as `resume_scheduled_at`). Must be after the pause takes effect and before any scheduled cancellation; not with `pause_option=billing_cycles`. |
| `plan_credits` | `object` | no | The business's plan credit rules, set for this call only. |
| `plan_credits.on_pause` | `string` | no | Plan credits on a reset window, for this pause only. `skip`: no grant for a window that starts while paused. `keep_granting`: grant as usual. `shift`: move the windows on by the time paused. A deferred pause carries it to the date it starts. Omitted: the business rule (`billing_rules_config.plan_credits.on_pause`). One of `skip`, `keep_granting`, `shift`. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `created_through` | `object` | What created this record, read from its creation event. `source` is `api`, `dashboard`, `assistant`, `portal`, `checkout`, `webhook`, `mcp`, `scheduled_job`, `migration`, `system` or `hubspot`. `actor` is the member's email for `dashboard`, the gateway key for `webhook`, an API key id for `api`, and null when none applies. Null on the whole object when no creation was recorded. Retrieve only, not on lists. |
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `id` | `string` | The subscription's id (sub_…). |
| `status` | `string` | The subscription's status. One of `future`, `in_trial`, `active`, `non_renewing`, `paused`, `cancelled`. |
| `currency` | `string` | The subscription's currency (ISO-4217 code). |
| `current_period_end` | `string · ISO-8601` | The current billing term end. NULL while `in_trial` — a trial is not a term, so a trialling subscription reports `trial_end` instead and this is null (one or the other is reported, never both). Use `next_billing_at` for "when is this customer charged again?", which answers across every status. |
| `next_billing_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the next invoice will be raised: trial end while in_trial, the scheduled start while future, the first renewal not skipped while active (or the next monthly usage invoice, when it is earlier); null once non_renewing/paused/cancelled, where no further invoice is due |
| `bill_usage_monthly` | `boolean` | Metered usage is invoiced every month inside the billing period. |
| `current_sub_period_start` | `string · ISO-8601` | Monthly usage billing: usage before this instant is billed. Null when monthly usage billing is off. |
| `current_sub_period_end` | `string · ISO-8601` | Monthly usage billing: when the next monthly usage invoice is raised. Null when off. |
| `commitment` | `object` | Minimum commitment for one full billing period, or null. See GET /subscriptions/{id}/commitment for the counted fees. |
| `skipped_renewals` | `array of string · ISO-8601` | Upcoming renewals scheduled to be skipped, as the instants the clock renews at. See `skip_renewal`. |
| `pending_change` | `object` | `billing_rules_config.failed_change_charge: apply_when_paid`: a change held until its invoice is paid. Nothing in it applies before then. Null when nothing is held. GET (detail) only. Cancel it with `DELETE …/subscriptions/{sub}/pending_change`. |
| `recurring_amount_minor` | `integer` | What one billing period charges for the recurring items, in minor units, net of discounts that last more than one period and before tax; null when cancelled or when an item recurs on a different cadence than the subscription |
| `revenue_billed_minor` | `integer` | DERIVED, read-only: this subscription's lifetime net billed revenue in its currency. Before tax, less discounts, promotional and plan credits, usage paid by a credit pack at its cost, and credit notes. Credit notes are deducted on their own issue date, so the total can be negative. Emitted by GET (detail) only. |
| `revenue_to_date_minor` | `integer` | DERIVED, read-only: cash collected on this subscription's invoices, in its currency — succeeded payments minus succeeded refunds, tax included. Credit applied to its invoices is excluded: promotional credit, plan credits, credit pack credit and account credit. A credit note reduces it only when it is refunded as money. This is cash, not `revenue_billed` (net, before tax). Emitted by GET (detail) only. |
| `revenue_paid_invoices_count` | `integer` | How many of this subscription's invoices received a succeeded payment. |
| `revenue_since` | `string · ISO-8601` | The first succeeded payment on this subscription; null when nothing was collected. |
| `custom_fields` | `object` | Stored custom-field values; also flattened onto the object as cf_&lt;name&gt; |
| `metadata` | `object` | Your own key-value data: set on create, by a checkout's `metadata`, or by an update. Never interpreted. |
| `customer` | `string` | The customer's id. Present on retrieve and on create. |
| `shipping_address_id` | `string` | The shipping address this subscription is set to ship to; null when it ships to the customer's default. Emitted by GET (detail), create, and an update that sends it. |
| `shipping_address` | `object` | Where this subscription ships now: its own address, else the customer's default, else null. Invoices record a copy when they are issued. |
| `items` | `array of object` | The subscription's items (plan, add-ons, usage prices). On retrieve, list, create and update. |
| `current_period_start` | `string · ISO-8601` | The current billing term start. Null while `in_trial`. |
| `trial_start` | `string · ISO-8601` | The subscription's trial start. |
| `trial_end` | `string · ISO-8601` | The subscription's trial end. |
| `cancel_at_period_end` | `boolean` | The subscription's cancel at period end. |
| `canceled_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When it was cancelled; for a subscription scheduled to cancel, when it will cancel. |
| `cancel_reason` | `string` | The subscription's cancel reason. |
| `cancel_reason_code` | `string` | The subscription's cancel reason code. |
| `start_date` | `string · ISO-8601` | The requested start, for a backdated or future-dated subscription. |
| `started_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the subscription started (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `activated_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | The activated time (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `billing_period` | `integer` | Interval count of the billing term. |
| `billing_period_unit` | `string` | The subscription's billing period unit. One of `day`, `week`, `month`, `year`. |
| `remaining_billing_cycles` | `integer` | Cycles left after the current one; null renews until cancelled. |
| `auto_collection` | `string` | This subscription's setting; null follows the customer's. One of `on`, `off`. |
| `create_pending_invoices` | `boolean` | The subscription's create pending invoices. |
| `net_term_days` | `integer` | The subscription's net term days. |
| `po_number` | `string` | The purchase order number. |
| `invoice_notes` | `string` | The subscription's invoice notes. |
| `max_refundable_credits_usage_minor` | `integer` | The max refundable credits usage in minor units (integer), e.g. 2900 = $29.00. |
| `max_excess_payment_usage_minor` | `integer` | The max excess payment usage in minor units (integer), e.g. 2900 = $29.00. |
| `mrr` | `integer` | Monthly recurring revenue in minor units; 0 while in a trial. |
| `default_payment_method` | `string` | The payment method this subscription charges (`pm_…`); null charges the customer's primary. On retrieve. |
| `discount` | `object` | The active discount, or null. On retrieve. |
| `due_invoices_count` | `integer` | Unpaid invoices that are due. On retrieve. The invoice of a `pending_change` is not counted: it is voided unless paid. |
| `total_dues_minor` | `integer` | Their amount due. On retrieve. |
| `due_since` | `string · ISO-8601` | The subscription's due since. |
| `customer_email` | `string` | On list. |
| `customer_name` | `string` | On list. |
| `customer_company` | `string` | On list. |
| `customer_phone` | `string` | On list. |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the subscription was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `updated_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the subscription was last changed (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `resource_version` | `integer` | A number that goes up on every change. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/subscriptions/sub_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/pause" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "pause_option": "immediately",
    "pause_date": "2026-03-14T09:30:00Z"
  }'
```
